releaseNotes: Split domain.money's single 332-line revenue-monetization.md monolith (RevenueCat + Stripe + IAP products + paywalls + subscriptions + entitlements + webhooks + billing health + reactivation, all in one file) into a routing hub plus four spokes (revenuecat-and-store-products.md, stripe-and-web-billing.md, paywall-pricing-and-experiments.md, billing-health-and-reactivation.md), mirroring the repo's existing tool-recipes.md and experience-cards.md hub-and-spoke pattern. Fixed every cross-reference this created or exposed: two catalog/references.ts entries carrying byte-identical loadWhen text for distinct files, a duplicated ANALYTICS.md 'required sections' checklist across two files, drifted Higgsfield routing prose, a drifted engineering-orchestration.md role restatement, and money/trust independently instructing webhook-signature rules with no cross-reference.

Added a dependency edge from the App Store listing prep workflow to the money workflow so RevenueCat/Stripe product setup runs before the same IAP products are named in store listing fields, and extended check-store-console-packet.ts to cross-check revenue/REVENUE_OPS.md's Products And Offering table against store/STORE_CONSOLE.md by product ID instead of a bare RevenueCat keyword grep, so the same product created independently on both sides no longer passes silently.

Relocated 5 validator scripts (check-live-provider-proof.ts, check-continuity-contract.ts, validate-project-state.ts, check-parallel-orchestration.ts, check-content-assets.ts, check-email.ts) to the validation/business/ domain folders their content actually belongs to, per check-gates-layout.ts's directory-derived ownership; catalog/gates.ts's directory-inferred gate ownership was misattributing them by path.

Added check:hub-spoke, a repository gate verifying that every knowledge/ spoke file's 'Part of the [Hub]' backlink is reciprocated by a link back from the hub's own routing content — catching a spoke that silently drops out of its hub's table (or points at the wrong hub) mechanically instead of only on the next audit.
